Testers – 12 Testers Community | App Testing & Beta Testing Platform

Testers – 12 Testers Community is an app testing platform where developers and testers connect to improve mobile apps before release. Join a growing testers community and discover opportunities for app testing, beta testing, open testing, and closed testing.
Whether you want to test apps or test your app, Testers makes the process simple and efficient.

 Test Apps Before Release
Become an app tester and explore new apps shared by developers. Join open testing or closed testing programs and try new features before they launch on the Play Store.

For Developers
Developers can easily test android apps by publishing them to the testers community. Use this app testing tool to find beta testers, collect feedback, and fix issues before releasing your app publicly.

Join the Testers Community
Connect with a community of beta testers and developers who collaborate to improve app quality. Participate in testing groups and help build better apps through feedback.

 Improve Apps with Feedback
Test apps, report bugs, and provide valuable insights using a powerful app feedback tool designed for developers and testers.

 Key Features
• Discover apps available for app testing and beta testing
• Join open testing and closed testing programs
• Become an app tester and test apps before launch
• Developers can test my app with real users
• Powerful developer testing platform
• Share feedback and improve apps together


Join the Testers – 12 Testers Community and start testing apps today. Help developers launch better apps with real user feedback.
